name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for your ADU project is crucial for a successful outcome. Look for a licensed and insured contractor with proven experience in ADU construction specifically, not just general remodeling. Review their portfolio, check references, and read client testimonials. Ensure they have a clear communication process, provide detailed proposals, and are knowledgeable about local ADU regulations in your area, such as North Hollywood or Studio City. A reputable contractor will also offer transparent pricing and a realistic timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with ADU-specific experience, a strong portfolio, good references, clear communication, and knowledge of local regulations.
